comment: H512+PP's tensors as Fork's training program saves them (tools/train --arch h512pp; bake-off round 3's option a, owner 2026-11-14, architecture 9), in save order: 768 piece rows per own-king region (each with H-512's shared factoriser merged in when saved), then the 608 pawn-link rows of rank limit 1 shared by every region (S512+PP's), the output layer transposed to one bucket's weights per row; read by convert.py and reference.py. The regions are the map M4 (XGR's fixed regions of the mirrored own-king cell: e1; f1-h1; rank 2; ranks 3-8; docs/research/bakeoff-r3/king-inputs-design.md, option a). The phase table is S512+PP's (s512pp.json), so a warm start from an S512+PP net keeps its output buckets.
name: h512pp
